plugins.name: pr-watch
plugins.description: Watches the PRs Claude opens: a band row with CI and merge state, merge buttons, and a nudge when one merges.

plugins.name: meter
plugins.description: Context, rate limits and cache hits above the prompt; /tokens charts token usage by day, repo, branch and model.

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: /fleet shows every live Claude Code session on this machine, and /send messages one.

plugins.name: quick
plugins.description: Instant commands that run without a Claude turn: /k, /links, /yank, /now.

plugins.name: auth-guard
plugins.description: Spots an expired CLI login in tool output and offers a Login button that signs in and retries.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: A checklist of the shell commands Claude hands you to run: captured from replies, ticked when you run them, confirmed by Claude.
